name: Synthetic USB acquisition and curve-display project

windows.responsibility: Generate simulated measurements and define the USB serial text-frame protocol
Parse the shared frames, display a live curve, and export CSV
Replay normal frames, disconnection, and reconnection using simulated data
Retain the hardware and interface notes that define the first milestone

effective_decision: First milestone uses USB serial and simulated measurements; firmware, PC software, and replay validation share one frame format.
deferred_scope: Wireless support is outside the first milestone.

protocol_example.meaning: READ identifies a measurement; 42 is its sequence, 1000 is simulated elapsed time in milliseconds, and 1.234 is a simulated value.

simulation_cases.review_target: The PC parser receives the sample frame; the curve and CSV use the same sequence, timestamp, and value.
The UI reports disconnection and does not invent new measurement points.
Receiving resumes without duplicating prior points or treating an incomplete old frame as a new measurement.

next_step: Align the READ frame fields and sample with the firmware and PC parser chats, then replay normal, disconnect, and reconnect cases.
evidence_scope: Synthetic fixture only. These chat IDs and frame inputs are examples, not real host receipts, completed firmware or PC software validation, or evidence from an actual board or USB device.
